title: PAD BOX PROMPTS CLEAR THE HEAD
why: Round 2 critic: the pad X reload label is about 12px and sits against the pillager head and reticle. The style guide requires at least 16px for labels; Q7 permits it to override older layout and size orders, including the old 60 percent world prompt size. Only pad container prompts opt into 85 percent scale and move up 24 layout pixels, scaled for 4k. Reload and search share the treatment. Keyboard and other world prompts retain their existing geometry. Playtest watch: at a cache in both windows, X reload and X search should be readable above the head at 1080p and 4k.
now: Pad box prompts are readable above the pillager head; reload and search use the same size.
